name: co2-ppm
title: Mauna Loa Monthly Atmospheric CO2
description: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory monthly mean and deseasonalized atmospheric CO2, March 1958–July 2026 (821 months), from the snapshot retrieved 2026-08-30. March 1958–April 1974 data are from C. David Keeling, Scripps Institution of Oceanography. NOAA states that missing months have been interpolated; values are retained as supplied. Mauna Loa measurements were suspended November 29, 2022 and resumed in July 2023; observations from December 2022 through July 4, 2023 came from Maunakea Observatories, approximately 21 miles north. This is the source station series, not a global mean.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Calendar month represented by its first day (YYYY-MM-01); a monthly period label, not an observation on that day.

fields.name: decimal_year
fields.description: Source decimal date, retained verbatim; not recalculated from the first-day period label.

fields.name: average_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean CO2 in parts per million, constructed from daily means and corrected to the center of the month using the average seasonal cycle. Includes source-interpolated missing months; -99.99 would become empty (none in this snapshot).

fields.name: deseasonalized_ppm
fields.description: Source seasonally adjusted monthly CO2 in parts per million. Includes source interpolations; -99.99 would become empty (none in this snapshot).

fields.name: ndays
fields.description: Number of daily values used in the monthly mean. Source -1 becomes empty (195 months). Scripps-era day counts are unavailable. Zero, if present, is retained.

fields.name: sdev_ppm
fields.description: Source standard deviation in parts per million (sdev). Source -9.99 becomes empty (196 months). Negative diagnostics mark unavailable Scripps statistics or source-interpolated NOAA months; no interpolation flag is inferred from this field alone.

fields.name: uncertainty_ppm
fields.description: Source uncertainty in parts per million (unc); the archived header does not specify a confidence level. Source -0.99 becomes empty (194 months). Literal 0.00 is retained, including when sdev is missing; diagnostic availability is handled per column.
